description: A collection of functions for handling protobuf serialization/deserialization in PySpark, including from_protobuf and to_protobuf functions, with internal file reading and testing utilities.

methods.name: from_protobuf
methods.description: Converts protobuf data to a Spark Column, with optional descriptor file or descriptor set bytes and options.

methods.name: to_protobuf
methods.description: Serializes a Spark Column to protobuf format, with optional descriptor file or descriptor set bytes and options.

methods.name: _read_descriptor_set_file
methods.description: Reads a binary descriptor set from a file.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Runs internal tests for protobuf functions, including environment setup and Spark session management.
